entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: The sixth sphere of New Phyrexia, aligned with black mana, formed from the former Mephidross and ruled by Thanes and Sheoldred.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane hollowed out and restructured into New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian who seized control of the Dross Pits by deceit.

entities.name: Roxith
entities.description: Thane who promised the Flesh Layer to Kraynox and was tricked by Sheoldred.

entities.name: Kraynox
entities.description: Phyrexian for whom the Flesh Sphere was meant.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Owner of a fortress of black bone and red sinew in the Dross Pits.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian whose throne Geth's fortress parodies.

entities.name: Thanes
entities.description: Black-aligned Phyrexian warlords who carved out fiefdoms.

entities.name: Sheoldred's Coliseum
entities.description: A monstrous arena at the heart of the pits.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: One of the few to escape the Coliseum, deeply scarred.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who ripped the Coliseum from the layer and dropped it on the Fair Basilica.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: Toxic swampland of Mirrodin siphoned into the Dross Pits.

events.summary: Sheoldred tricked Roxith into ceding control of the Flesh Sphere, and the Thanes carved out fiefdoms.
events.quote: Sheoldred tricked Roxith into ceding control.

events.summary: Mirrodin was fully compleated; the Mephidross was siphoned into the sixth layer, becoming the Dross Pits.
events.quote: The Mephidross was siphoned into the sixth layer, becoming the Dross Pits.

events.summary: During the Invasion of New Phyrexia, Nahiri ripped the Coliseum from the layer and dropped it onto the Fair Basilica.
events.quote: During the Invasion of New Phyrexia, Nahiri ripped the Coliseum from the layer and dropped it onto the Fair Basilica.

relations.quote: ruled by the scheming Thanes and dominated by Sheoldred
The Dross Pits are the sixth sphere of New Phyrexia
